category_title: Blind student with selective mutism and high receptive language skills
scenario_title: Initial introduction of a new voice-output communication device
minimal_context: Sally is sitting at a table with her teacher to practice communicating a choice using a new four-button voice-output device.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Sally, we have a new voice-output device on the table today. This is the big button communicator.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent, pushes the device away from her and refuses to use it.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's bring it back. Please use the device to communicate a choice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent and places her arm across all four buttons.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to pick one. Go ahead and press a button.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps her arm placed across all four buttons, rather than use the device appropriately to communicate a choice.)
